rig.device_model: lying-fsync device model: cache=unsafe accepts fsync but does not flush to the host image
rig.claim: VM power-cut proxy plus lying-fsync device model: SIGKILL loses guest page cache and QEMU user-space state, and cache=unsafe ignores flush requests; this is not physical media power loss
rig.data_disk: qcow2 overlay on raw ext4 128 MiB, fresh per iteration
rig.kill: SIGKILL to qemu-system-x86_64 with no guest shutdown and no cache flush
rig.qemu_command_template: qemu-system-x86_64 -accel kvm -cpu host -smp 1 -m 512M -kernel /boot/vmlinuz-6.1.0-54-amd64 -initrd /boot/initrd.img-6.1.0-54-amd64 -append 'root=/dev/vda ro rootfstype=ext4 rootwait console=ttyS0,115200 panic=-1 loglevel=4 weft.mode=<write|verify> weft.iters=100000' -drive file=/work/.docker-cache/powerloss/20261104T014805Z/root.img,if=virtio,format=raw,readonly=on -drive file=/work/.docker-cache/powerloss/20261104T014805Z/data.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2,cache=unsafe -display none -vga none -no-user-config -nodefaults -no-reboot -serial stdio -monitor none

environment.host_kernel: Linux 0280382acbed 7.3.1-1-cachyos #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 31 Oct 2026 06:43:52 +0000 x86_64 GNU/Linux

limits.unsynced_control: one byte appended to /data/unsynced-control after each returned commit, never fsynced; a size below the observed commit count proves the rig discarded guest page cache

commands.court: scripts/docker-court.sh vm "POWERLOSS_ITERATIONS=30 POWERLOSS_SEED=20261103 POWERLOSS_CACHE_MODE=unsafe bash scripts/powerloss_court.sh"
commands.guest_write: weftfs --store /data/store init --chunk-size 65536 --checkpoint-interval 5 --gc-grace-secs 0; weftfs --store /data/store create /f --file /tmp/base --seed powerloss-base; loop: weftfs --store /data/store --json write /f --offset 0 --file /tmp/payload
commands.guest_verify: weftfs --store /data/store --json info; weftfs --store /data/store --json verify --full; weftfs --store /data/store cat /f; go-weftfs --store /data/store --json info; go-weftfs --store /data/store --json verify --full; go-weftfs --store /data/store cat /f
commands.qemu: qemu-system-x86_64 -accel kvm -cpu host -smp 1 -m 512M -kernel /boot/vmlinuz-6.1.0-54-amd64 -initrd /boot/initrd.img-6.1.0-54-amd64 -append 'root=/dev/vda ro rootfstype=ext4 rootwait console=ttyS0,115200 panic=-1 loglevel=4 weft.mode=<write|verify> weft.iters=100000' -drive file=/work/.docker-cache/powerloss/20261104T014805Z/root.img,if=virtio,format=raw,readonly=on -drive file=/work/.docker-cache/powerloss/20261104T014805Z/data.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2,cache=unsafe -display none -vga none -no-user-config -nodefaults -no-reboot -serial stdio -monitor none

scope.asserted: for every completed iteration under the lying-fsync device model, both implementations recover the same generation; that state is exactly the expected whole state; every commit that returned before SIGKILL is still present; verify --full is clean
not_asserted: a real disk whose firmware lies about flush semantics; cache=unsafe is a device model
power loss during mkfs or during the read-only root mount
